question: What are the most influential papers on VEGF angiogenesis? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on VEGF angiogenesis, based on citation counts, include foundational studies on the biology of VEGF receptors, its role as a secreted angiogenic mitogen, and the impact of hypoxia on VEGF-mediated angiogenesis.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/nm0603-669","title":"The biology of VEGF and its receptors","citation_count":8665},{"doi":"10.1126/science.2479986","title":"Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor Is a Secreted Angiogenic Mitogen","citation_count":4925},{"doi":"10.1038/359843a0","title":"Vascular endothelial growth factor induced by hypoxia may mediate hypoxia-initiated angiogenesis","citation_count":4537},{"doi":"10.1038/376062a0","title":"Failure of blood-island formation and vasculogenesis in Flk-1-deficient mice","citation_count":3673},{"doi":"10.1038/380439a0","title":"Heterozygous embryonic lethality induced by targeted inactivation of the VEGF gene","citation_count":3667}]}
